- After **Nxf7**, White forks the king and queen
- If **Bxh6**, White plays **Nxh6+** winning the bishop with check
- If **Kxf7**, White plays **Qxf8+** winning the bishop

This is a devastating knight fork that wins material in all variations. The motif is "fork".

**Best move:** Nxf7

**Main line:** Nxf7 Kxf7 Qxf8+ Kxf8 (or Rxf8) and White has won the bishop, up significant material.

**Motif:** fork

**Explanation (coaching note):**
You missed a textbook knight fork! Your knight on g5 forks the king and queen from f7. After Black moves the king, your queen captures the undefended bishop on f8 with check. This wins a full piece. When your knight reaches an attacking square deep in the enemy position, always check if it forks the king—most pieces can't move to both defend against the attack and block the fork.
